payload.title: Console loading audit: what each newsroom surface reads, and paging design
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-10: is the newsroom UI loading every story every time? Audit of every console surface (what loads, how much, how often), ranked by cost, with a paging/lazy-loading design and schema implications: docs/plans/console-loading-audit.md. First slices: board columns on the head stage index behind SiteBrand.storyHeadStageIndex (PPY-52f3da); opening a story no longer scans the SemanticRelation table (editor reads the newest version with one indexed row; trail reads References by subject state). Follow-ups listed in the doc's Order section.
